description: Manage your Claude Code tmux sessions and their Remote Control from VS Code.
cmd.importRunning: Add running windows to restore-on-boot list
cfg.tmuxSession: Name of the tmux session that holds the Claude windows.
cfg.projectDir: Project directory. Empty = the folder open in VS Code.
cfg.claudeBin: Path to the claude command. Empty = look it up in PATH.
cfg.sessionsFile: JSON file with the sessions restored after a reboot. Empty = ~/.config/claude-tmux/sessions.json.
cfg.services: systemd user services to show (only those that exist are listed).
cmd.serverSetup: Set up a Remote Control server
cfg.serverAutoUpdate: Run "claude update" once each time a Remote Control server starts. Off by default: updating can change the launcher.
cmd.checkUnits: Check services for the KillMode risk
